test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sparse_prewhere_array_runs (k UInt64, f_short_runs String, f_long_runs String, a Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.8
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sparse_prewhere_array_runs SELECT number, number % 80 < 8 ? toString(number) : '', number % 8192 >= 5120 AND number % 8192 < 5940 ? toString(number) : '', arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(cityHash64(number, x) % 200), range(cityHash64(number, 1) % 7)) FROM numbers(33554432)
test.query: SELECT max(arraySum(a)) FROM sparse_prewhere_array_runs PREWHERE f_short_runs != '' SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT max(arraySum(a)) FROM sparse_prewhere_array_runs PREWHERE f_long_runs != '' SETTINGS max_threads = 1
